notes.type_correctness: TypeScript compiles cleanly. MainMenu and GameOverOverlay follow correct PixiJS v8 API patterns.
notes.pattern_adherence: MainMenu mirrors SplashScreen constructor signature for drop-in replacement. GameOverOverlay follows PauseModal hidden-by-default lifecycle. Tests follow pauseModal.test.ts mock pattern.
notes.test_coverage: 31 new tests covering construction, flushActions buffer drain, onExit/onReturnToMenu callbacks, resize, destroy, show/hide idempotency, and score text population.
